items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: it was used in an educational sense by Barry Harris. He started that baby up.

ctx.x: What was it like studying with Tiny Grimes?

Ah, well there’s another one. Now I really got a concept of sound from him too. Tiny, I mean he was very down to earth, very straight ahead. And of course he was only maybe around for a few more years after from I first met him and started studying with him. But like Tiny now, a couple of quick anecdotes about Tiny, when I first met him I just saw like a poster in the neighborhood, I was living Uptown, about him playing at the Jazz Cultural Center, which was a place — they presented concerts — but also it was…
